Alger, 29 octobre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, October 29, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The Ministry of Post and ICT warns against supposedly free streaming applications of unknown origin, which could compromise device security and personal data.
Le Ministère de la Poste et des Télécomm: The Ministry of Post and Telecommunications, Technologies and Digital Economy is sounding the alarm regarding content broadcasting applications, often presented as "100% free" but whose source remains mysterious. These unofficial applications can conceal malicious programs designed to take control of smartphones and user accounts, thus exposing sensitive information. It is therefore imperative to download applications exclusively from recognized official distribution platforms. Before any installation, a thorough check of the source and reliability of the application is recommended in order to prevent any digital scam attempt and protect personal data.
